evidence_quote: For the energy diagnosis, the current consumption (at least three months) of raw materials, energy resources (electricity, water) and production is recorded and analysed. Mass and energy balances are provided, as well as juice flow, steam consumption, thermal power and evaporator vapour flows, which are essential heat and mass flows for estimating energy performance indicators (EnPIs) or SEC, also for applying the pinch analysis method.

Energy Performance Indicators (EnPIs) are determined by applying energy analysis and heat integration. The pinch analysis methodology is used to determine network targets, minimum temperature difference and maximum energy recovery (MER) [10].
